-- Probe floor at arena XZ from multiple heights
local results = {}

local function probe(x, z, label)
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 500, z), Vector3.new(0, -600, 0), rp)
	if result then
		table.insert(results, string.format("%s → hit '%s' at Y=%.2f (material=%s)", 
			label, result.Instance.Name, result.Position.Y, tostring(result.Material)))
	else
		table.insert(results, label .. " → NO HIT (nothing below)")
	end
end

-- Arena center
probe(1012, 1007, "Arena center (1012,1007)")
-- A few offsets
probe(1000, 1000, "Offset (-12,-7)")
probe(1020, 1010, "Offset (+8,+3)")
probe(1012, 1007, "Arena center again")

-- Also check if there's a Baseplate or terrain
local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
local baseplate = workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
table.insert(results, "Terrain exists: " .. tostring(terrain ~= nil))
table.insert(results, "Baseplate exists: " .. tostring(baseplate ~= nil))
if baseplate then
	table.insert(results, "Baseplate Y: " .. tostring(baseplate.Position.Y))
	table.insert(results, "Baseplate size: " .. tostring(baseplate.Size))
end

-- Check what parts are near arena center
local count = 0
for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Anchored then
		local dx = math.abs(part.Position.X - 1012)
		local dz = math.abs(part.Position.Z - 1007)
		if dx < 60 and dz < 60 then
			count += 1
			if count <= 8 then
				table.insert(results, string.format("  AnchoredPart: '%s' at Y=%.1f size=%s", 
					part.Name, part.Position.Y, tostring(part.Size)))
			end
		end
	end
end
table.insert(results, "Total anchored parts near arena: " .. count)

return table.concat(results, "\n")
